task: You are now playing a fast paced game of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, attempt to head west. After that, pick-up the type 4 key from the floor of the bedchamber. After that, move east. Then, unlock the type 4 locker in the cellar. Then, doublecheck that the type 4 locker is opened. And then, take the fresh laundry scented key from the type 4 locker inside the cellar. After stealing the fresh laundry scented key, go to the west. After that, make absolutely sure that the fresh laundry scented gateway is open. And then, move north. Once you finish that, venture west. Next, make an attempt to travel west. Then, make an attempt to go south. And then, lift the key from the floor of the studio. And if you do that, you're the winner!
